meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Prime Video: hide the Join Prime button, New/Top 10 badges and X-Ray; show, blur or hide poster art; footer toggle.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on www.primevideo.com/ (redirected to /region/eu/). Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (Chrome/network were out of memory when retried; the mobile web mostly points to the app), a title detail page, the player, anything signed in.

LIVE counts on the landing page: join-prime desktop home 2; promo-badges desktop home 112; artwork-blur desktop home 223; artwork-hide desktop home 223; footer desktop home 1. Selectors are `data-testid` values (pv-nav-join-prime, metadata-badge, base-image) and the footer id; the page's hashed classes (`dJLfVG`) are never used. The x-ray rule is SOURCE only (r/AmazonPrimeVideo "Disable IMDB X-Ray on web browser" and a uBlock Origin filter in r/uBlockOrigin), its fixture desktop-player.html is hand-written, and the element was not seen live.

Choice: Title artwork Show/Blur/Hide (blur 14px) on `base-image` only, so title links remain clickable. The packshot and carousel containers are never hidden.

NOT verified: detail pages, the player, the Next Up badge (the blog source gives no selector), signed-in UI, regional landing pages other than /region/eu/, Prime Video ads (video ads cannot be hidden).
